description_en: Retrieves the details of a connection
name: GetConnection

parameters.help_en: The connection ID. For more information about how to obtain a connection ID, see [ListConnections](url)
parameters.help_zh: 连接ID。如何获取连接 ID，详情请参见 [ListConnections](url)
parameters.name: connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The encryption setting. Valid values:

PlainText: The value is in plaintext.

Secret: The value is in ciphertext
parameters.help_zh:
加密设置。可取值：
PlainText：明文。
Secret：密文
parameters.name: encrypt_option

Accessibility.description_en:
The visibility of the resource. Valid values:

PUBLIC: All members in the current workspace can access the resource.

PRIVATE: Only the creator can access the resource
Accessibility.description_zh:
资源可见性，取值如下：

PUBLIC：当前工作空间所有成员都可以访问。
PRIVATE：只有创建者可以访问

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of a connection configuration

Configs.description_en: The configuration information of the connection

ConnectionType.description_en:
The type of the connection. Valid values:

DashScopeConnection: A connection to a Model Studio service.

OpenLLMConnection: A connection to an open-source model.

MilvusConnection: A connection to Milvus.

OpenSearchConnection: A connection to OpenSearch.

LindormConnection: A connection to Lindorm.

ElasticsearchConnection: A connection to Elasticsearch.

HologresConnection: A connection to Hologres.

RDSConnection: A connection to RDS.

CustomConnection: A custom connection
ConnectionType.description_zh:
连接的类型。可能值：

DashScopeConnection：百炼服务连接。
OpenLLMConnection：开源模型连接。
MilvusConnection：Milvus连接。
OpenSearchConnection：OpenSearch连接。
LindormConnection：Lindorm连接。
ElasticsearchConnection：Elasticsearch连接。
HologresConnection：Hologres连接。
RDSConnection：RDS连接。
CustomConnection：自定义连接

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The UTC time when the connection was created. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 创建连接的UTC时间，时间格式为ISO8601

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The UTC time when the connection was last modified. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改连接的UTC时间，时间格式为ISO8601

Models.description_en: The list of models. This parameter is applicable to connections of the model service type
Models.description_zh: 模型列表。适用于模型服务类型的连接

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the model

ModelType.description_en:
The model type. Valid values:

LLM: A large language model (LLM).

Embedding: An embedding model.

ReRank: A reranking model
ModelType.description_zh:
模型类型，取值为：
LLM：大语言模型。
Embedding：Embedding模型。
ReRank：ReRank模型

ToolCall.description_en:
Indicates whether tool calling is supported. Valid values:

true: Tool calling is supported.

false: Tool calling is not supported
ToolCall.description_zh:
是否支持ToolCall工具调用。可取值：
true：支持
false：不支持

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

ResourceMeta.description_en: The instance resource information of the connection. This parameter is typically used for database connections
ResourceMeta.description_zh: 连接的实例资源信息。一般适用于数据库类型的连接

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of an encrypted connection configuration

Secrets.description_en: The key-value pairs that need to be encrypted. Examples include the logon password for a database and the key for a model connection
Secrets.description_zh: 需要加密的Key-Value配置。如数据库登录密码，模型连接的Key等
